transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this waste-disposition huddle started. We've got eighteen totes of spent solvent from the cleaning process staged in the waste area, and they're awaiting disposition. I know no pickup has been booked yet, and the waste area can hold them until I authorize shipment. Before I can sign off on the disposition and shipment plan, we need to go through the compliance and logistics reports in full, per our policy. So let's hear from compliance first, then logistics, and then I'll make the disposition decision. Who's ready to start?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical compliance issue before we proceed. My laboratory review this morning reclassified the spent solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II — it is no longer classified as routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. I have not yet entered the reclassification into the formal waste register because I'm waiting on the plant manager's disposition signature to finalize it.
